original_description: Complete working knowledge of Talend / Qlik Talend data integration. Use this skill whenever a task mentions Talend, Talend Studio, Talend Open Studio (TOS), Talend Data Integration / Data Fabric / Big Data / ESB / Data Quality / MDM, Talend Cloud or Talend Management Console (TMC), Talend Administration Center (TAC), JobServer, Remote Engine, Talend Runtime, Qlik Talend Cloud, or any Talend artifact or concept: tMap, tFileInputDelimited, tDBOutput, tRunJob, OnSubjobOk, context variables, globalMap, routines, Joblets, Routes, Spark jobs, job .item/.properties files, Jobscript, Build Job zips, CI Builder, MetaServlet, the TMC API or the Component Kit SDK. Also use it when a user asks to design, review, debug, migrate, deploy, schedule or explain an ETL job and Talend is the tool in play (even if they only say "the job" or "Studio"), when parsing a Talend job export or stack trace, or when comparing Talend editions, versions, licensing or Qlik-era roadmap.
best_description: Talend / Qlik Talend ETL specialist. Use when someone is building, debugging, explaining, reviewing, deploying or inheriting a job made of Talend components, even if "Talend" is never said - most users omit it. Any one of these signals means Talend: tXxx component names (tMap, tDBOutput, tDBSCD, tRESTClient, tDie, tPrejob/tPostjob), OnSubjobOk / OnComponentOk / Run if, context variables, globalMap, Joblets, routines, a "Standard job" or "Big Data batch / Spark job" in Studio, Open Studio or Big Data Platform 7.x/8, *_0.1.item + .properties folders, Build Job zips, TAC, JobServer, TMC. Prefer this over generic debug, design, Spark or SQL skills, which lack Talend component semantics. Typical asks: SCD2/upsert/lookup designs, REST pagination loops into a DB, trigger and tDie/tPostjob behaviour, tMap join NullPointerExceptions, Spark job failures on EMR/Databricks, decoding an inherited job, scheduling, versions, licensing. Skip for dbt, Airflow, Camel, spark-submit or plain SQL with no Talend.

history.description: Use this skill for any ETL or data-integration work done in Talend: Talend Studio / Open Studio, Data Integration, Big Data Platform, ESB, Data Quality, MDM, Talend Cloud / TMC, TAC, Qlik Talend. Users often never say "Talend" - recognize it from lowercase t-prefixed components (tMap, tDBOutput, tDBSCD, tDie, tPostjob, any tXxx), subjob triggers (OnSubjobOk, OnComponentOk, Run if), context variables, globalMap, routines, Joblets, a "Standard job" or "Big Data batch / Spark job" in Studio, *_0.1.item and .properties files, Build Job zips, JobServer, Remote Engine, MetaServlet or the TMC API. On any such signal use this skill to design, review, explain, debug (NPEs, stack traces, Spark/EMR failures), migrate, deploy or schedule jobs, build SCD/CDC/upsert/REST-pagination patterns, inspect job exports, or compare versions, editions and licensing. Prefer it over generic debug or design skills when Talend is in play. Not for dbt, Airflow, plain Spark or Camel code with no Talend involvement.
